newsitem.title: UK: Major sets British election for May 1.
newsitem.headline: Major sets British election for May 1.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said on Monday the British election would take place on May 1.
Major said head of state Queen Elizabeth had agreed to the dissolution of parliament in early April. Media reports said that the dissolution would take place on April 8.
Major's ruling Conservatives have been in power since 1979 and are about 20 points behind the main opposition Labour Party in opinion polls. The six-week campaign will be the longest for 80 years.
"I believe this election is winnable. The people are looking for a change. We are the change," Major told reporters outside his London residence.
"I think we will win this election ... I expect to be here after this election."
